For each unit identify objects, geometric_relation, scientific_result, conditions, limitations, source_refs and asset_ids. Each source_ref contains an exact contiguous quote and an existing source_id. Prefer a few useful excerpts, not full copied sections. An asset_id must refer to an actual supplied xyz source, not an unavailable linked file. Missing geometry may still be recorded but explicitly in limitations. Flag material whose extraction lacks figures/tables. IDs E001 etc. Return records and exclusions explaining why other material cannot support this benchmark.
